user.title: Irrigation Scheduler
user.description: Waters your garden one tap at a time over scheduled cycles. Choose how many taps (valves) and cycles you need; both can be changed later.

data_description.name: Used for the device and entity names (Irrigation -> switch.irrigation_master).
data_description.tap_count: Unused taps can be left empty.
data_description.cycle_count: Each cycle has its own start time, days, and per tap minutes / run order / soak.

valves.title: Pick the valves
valves.description:
One valve (switch, valve or toggle helper) per tap. Toggle helpers are good for a first test. Everything else (names, minutes, sensors) is set afterwards under Configure or on the dashboard card.

The master switch starts OFF: nothing is scheduled until you turn it on. Manual runs (a tap switched on by hand) are timed from the start.

error.order_clash: Two taps can't share a run order ({clash}). Change one run order at a time to swap two taps, or give every tap its own number.

init.title: Irrigation Scheduler settings
init.description: Pick what to change. Each screen saves when you press Submit. Minutes, run order and soak can also be edited on the dashboard card.

menu_options.cycle_pick: Cycles: time, days, minutes, run order, soak
menu_options.tap_pick: Taps: valve, name, people sensors, soil, bypass
menu_options.general: General: gap, safety limit, seasonal source
menu_options.main: Main water: shut-off valve, tap-won't-close alert

cycle.title: Cycle {cycle}
cycle.description: Minutes 0 = Off (the tap is not in this cycle). Run order 1 runs first; every tap has its own number, so changing one swaps it with the tap that had it. This cycle's on/off switch is its own entity (Cycle {cycle}).

data_description.time: Avoid 02:00-03:00 (the daylight-saving change hour). If something is running, the start shifts later; it is never dropped.

data_description.order: 1 runs first. Every tap has its own number: pick one another tap has and the two swap.
data_description.soak: Water in short bursts with soak breaks (timing under Cycle-and-soak).

data_description.valve: switch, valve or toggle helper. Leave empty if unused.
data_description.name: Shown in notifications and on the card, e.g. Backyard Left.
data_description.people: Optional. Person sensors covering the area this tap waters (Frigate person occupancy, person count). See People guard.
data_description.soil: Optional. A soil moisture sensor (%) in this tap's area. Leave empty for e.g. the lawn.
data_description.soil_pct: This tap sits a cycle out at or above this. 0 = off. Tip: note the reading a day after a good soak and set a little below it. Part of Rain & weather skip.
data_description.bypass: Optional. While this is on (e.g. input_boolean.pressure_washer_bypass) the tap is left alone (no manual timer) and cycles wait until it is off.

data_description.gap_s: Pause after a tap reports off, before the next one opens.
data_description.confirm_s: How long to wait for a valve to report on / off (3 tries when closing).
data_description.max_run_min: No tap stays open longer than this in one go; longer taps run in parts. Also caps manual runs.
data_description.late_min: Cycles always run; starting later than this is flagged 'Running late'.
data_description.seasonal_entity: Optional. Use this input_number / sensor (%) instead of the app's Seasonal adjustment slider. Leave empty to switch this off.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Messages go to the phones you pick, in one group / thread; a newer message of the same type replaces the older one. Tap faults are always sent (time-sensitive on iOS).

data_description.prefix: Groups all messages and starts every tag, e.g. irrigation -> irrigation_cycle_1.
data_description.reminders: 20 and 10 min before a cycle while the master switch is off, with a 'Turn master switch on' button.
data_description.rain: When the rain sensor turns wet while the master switch is on (re-armed after 30 min dry).
data_description.hot_c: An alert after 10 min at or above this; also the hot-day boost trigger. 0 = off.

soak.title: Cycle-and-soak timing
soak.description: For taps with cycle-and-soak on: water a little, let it soak in, water again. Other taps run while one soaks.

people.title: People guard (cameras)
people.description: Uses each tap's people sensors. A tap does not start while someone is in its area and pauses if someone walks in; other taps run meanwhile.

data_description.clear_min: How long the area must be empty before the tap starts or carries on.
data_description.max_wait_min: When only people-blocked taps are left, wait this long, then skip them. 0 = wait as long as it takes.

weather.title: Rain & weather skip
weather.description: A cycle is skipped when ANY of these applies at its start. Soil moisture is per tap. Leave a sensor empty or a limit at 0 to switch that check off.

data_description.rain_sensor: Skip when it is 'on' or at/above the rain amount (a rain-today or 24 h total works well).
data_description.weather_entity: Skip when it is rainy / pouring now; also the forecast source, and the fallback for wind and temperature.
data_description.temp_sensor: Used by the cold skip, the too-hot alert and the hot-day boost.
data_description.boost_pct: Durations x this when it is at/above 'Too hot at' as a cycle starts (100 = off; max 250 % together with the seasonal %). Works even with the skip checks off.

main.title: Main water
main.description: The valve that supplies water to every tap. If a tap can't be confirmed off, the app keeps retrying every 5 min; once it has been stuck for the wait below you get a critical alert with a Close main water button (press and hold the notification). While the main water is off, cycles wait and run late once it is on again. The app never opens the main water by itself: you do, with the Open main water button.

data.wait_min: Alert after a tap is stuck for
data.remind_min: While it is off, remind me every

data_description.valve: Switch, valve, toggle helper or light (some relays show as a light). On = water flowing. Leave empty to switch this off.
data_description.wait_min: Counted from the moment a tap could not be confirmed off.
data_description.auto_close: Off: you are asked (critical alert with a Close main water button). On: the app closes it after the wait and tells you.
data_description.remind_min: Repeats until the main water is on again. Snooze from the notification (press and hold: Snooze 1 h, or Snooze… and type the hours); the reminders start again when the snooze ends. 0 = no reminders.
data_description.remind_cycle: 20 and 10 min before a cycle that would run while the main water is off (also while snoozed).

counts.title: Number of taps and cycles
counts.description: Changing these reloads the integration (the run in progress carries on).

state.held: Held (bypass on or main water off)

run_cycle.name: Run cycle now
run_cycle.description: Runs a cycle now (or after what is running), ignoring the master and cycle switches and the weather and soil checks.

stop.description: Closes the running tap (scheduled or manual) and cancels the running and waiting cycles.

skip_tap.name: Skip tap
skip_tap.description: Skips a tap for the rest of the running cycle.

config_entry_id.description: Only needed when you have more than one.

close_main_water.name: Close main water
close_main_water.description: Closes the main water valve (set under Main water). Cycles wait until it is open again.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when you have more than one.

open_main_water.name: Open main water
open_main_water.description: Opens the main water valve again. Waiting cycles then run (late).

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when you have more than one.

snooze_main_water_reminders.name: Snooze main water reminders
snooze_main_water_reminders.description: Pauses the 'main water is off' reminders. They start again when the time is up.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when you have more than one.

run_tap.name: Run tap
run_tap.description: Opens one tap as a manual run (any other open tap closes; a running cycle pauses).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long. Default: the tap's longest cycle minutes. Capped by the safety limit.
